column4: B.E. / B.Tech: 4 Academic Years (8 Semesters) under Anna University CBCS Regulations (R2021/R2025).
column5: Maximum time allowed to complete degree requirements is 14 consecutive semesters (7 years) for regular students and 12 semesters (6 years) for lateral entry.

column4: Total credits required for award of B.Tech / B.E. degree ranges between 160 – 165 credits across 8 semesters as prescribed by Anna University syllabus.
column5: Minimum 20 credits per semester average. Students can take additional professional electives or online NPTEL/SWAYAM courses for credit transfer (up to 3 credits).

column4: A candidate shall be declared to have passed an examination in a course if they obtain a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (Internal Assessment + End Semester Examination combined), with a minimum of 45% marks in End Semester Examination.
column5: Failing either aggregate or end-sem minimum results in 'RA' (Re-Appearance). Student must re-register and reappear for end-semester exam.

column4: Minimum 75% overall attendance is mandatory in each semester across all theory, practical, and blended courses to appear in Anna University End-Semester Examinations.
column5: Attendance between 65% and 74% may be condoned on valid medical grounds with medical certificate and condonation fee approval. Below 65% results in 'SA' (Shortage of Attendance - Prevention/Detention).

column4: Students are promoted to higher semesters irrespective of backlog arrears, provided they satisfy the minimum attendance requirement (>=75%).
column5: A student who is prevented ('SA') due to lack of attendance must repeat the semester in the subsequent academic year.
column6: promotion rules, backlog policy, detention, year repeat, attendance prevention

column4: 10-point letter grading system: O (10), A+ (9), A (8), B+ (7), B (6), C (5), RA (0 - Reappear), SA (0 - Shortage of Attendance), W (0 - Withdrawal).
column5: Grade 'C' (5.0 GP) is the lowest passing grade. Grades 'RA' and 'SA' carry 0 grade points and require cleared arrear exams.

column4: P.T. Lee Chengalvaraya Naicker Trust distributes Rs. 2+ Crores Trust Scholarship per annum. Special Cash Prize of Rs. 3,000 is awarded to students who pass all subjects in all semesters without arrears in an academic year.
column5: Additional scholarships include Dr. M. Viswanathan - Pavai Endowment Fund Scholarship, First Graduate Scholarship, and Post-Matric Government Scholarships.

column4: Free hostel accommodation is provided for boys and girls inside the campus with mess charges subsidized at Rs. 90/day. Fleet of GPS-enabled college buses operates across Kanchipuram, Arakkonam, Arcot, Tiruttani, Ranipet, and Vellore.
column5: Hostel entry deadline is 6:30 PM. Day-scholar students must carry valid bus passes issued by college transport office.
